selector: A: after opening a page from the list
reason: Opening a page from a list drops focus to body (the list unmounts). Batch 3 of 0.19.3 puts focus on the title.
After Save the bar closes and focus drops to body (the flow asks no notification question, so no dialog takes it). Batch 3 of 0.19.3 keeps focus on the text.
After Move down the block is re-rendered and focus drops to body. Batch 3 of 0.19.3 (focus after open and close) and batch 4 keep it on the moved block.
Edit dashboard and Done unmount the button that was pressed (src/DashboardGrid.tsx), so focus drops to body. Batch 3 of 0.19.3 keeps it on the control that replaces them.
Edit dashboard and Done unmount the button that was pressed (src/DashboardGrid.tsx), so focus drops to body. Batch 3 of 0.19.3 keeps it on the control that replaces them.

Remove is only in the bar's block group, which shows while a card is selected, and the bar is before the text: Shift+Tab to it passes through the text, which clears the selection. Batch 4 of 0.19.3 (card selected by keyboard, Delete removes it).

The text bar's tools unmount when the text loses focus (src/MarkdownEditor.tsx setInText), so Tab can never reach them and Alt+F10 does nothing. Batch 4 of 0.19.3 adds Alt+F10 and the toolbar pattern.

selector: F: a widget's Actions menu takes focus when it opens
reason: The editor's Menu (src/ui.tsx) keeps focus on its button when it opens, makes every item a Tab stop and ignores the arrow keys, unless it is attached. Batch 2 of 0.19.3 gives it the theme menu's keyboard behaviour.
